newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bangchak awards 600,000 bbls Tapis in Nov tender.
newsitem.headline: Bangchak awards 600,000 bbls Tapis in Nov tender.

text.p: SINGAPORE, Oct 7 (Sept) - Thailand's Bangchak Petroleum Plc has acquired 600,000 barrels of mid November Tapis crude oil, industry sources said on Monday.
The November 18-20 cargo was acquired at $1.15 premium to its benchmark quotes following Bangchak's November tender which closed late last week.
Bangchak had tendered to buy 600,000 barrels of light sweet Far East crude and 500,000 barrels of Gulf crude. By the validity date of Friday, Bangchak had not awarded any crudes, traders said.
